name: Being in Beauty
reason: Strict health rule: Peter's site (Being in Beauty) says on its Shamanic Healing page that shamanic healing has been proven very effective for trauma and physical illness, sells Soulight sessions against anxieties, and carries a sound healing testimonial about a chronic condition and improved blood test results, so a listing would send people to condition-sold sessions.
